title: Data flow real-time natural language processing
abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for identifying and locating related contents by utilizing natural language processing. One embodiment comprises an HTML5/JavaScript user interface, whichis configured to execute a script command to execute natural language processing and related content search, and is used for providing a dynamic interface to obtain and display user interaction and automatic methods of related contents. A keyword comprising a context-sensitive key term can be used for performing a search to locate and identify the related contents. For example, a text (such as atext from a caption or a closed caption) associated with a video of first contents can be used for executing the search and locating the related contents, such as a video of second contents or a textof third contents.
